articles.title: Star Wars animator says "the most important" scene for Jon Favreau in The Mandalorian and Grogu was a surprising Rotta moment
articles.summary: Industrial Light & Magic animation supervisor Hal Hickel highlighted the profound emotional significance of a scene in "The Mandalorian and Grogu" where Rotta and Grogu interact. He noted how this "impossibly sweet" moment resonated deeply with director Jon. This offers insight into the creative process and the artistic choices that shape character development in major cinematic productions, often leveraging advanced animation technologies.

articles.title: Lanterns Episode 4 Stills Reunite Hal Jordan And John Stewart In 2016 As Lianna Returns
articles.summary: HBO and DC Studios have released new stills for this Sunday's upcoming episode of 'Lanterns'. Following last weekend's 'shocking revelations', the narrative will reportedly see the character Hal Jordan returning to 2016. The new episode promises to continue the unfolding storyline for fans of the series, building on previous plot developments and delving into the established fictional universe.
